C-main-GIT-041 (d90f9e09aab6, 2026-10-09) records the replacement threshold policy. The checker limitation may predate that split; the package does not give its original implementation history, so regeneration remains an alternative if introduction is defined by the latent limitation.

C-main-GIT-040 (05b1be7ccc2b, 2026-10-10) is the correction, not the introducing commit.

C-main-REC-009 (CONGELAMENTO_E3.md, aa9f478b3fa8, line 102) and C-main-REG-020 (item 19) describe the E3 record-counting procedure including unrelated remeasurements. These establish presence in the frozen campaigns and subsequent repair, but not whether the leaking calculation was inherited from deliverable code or introduced in the workflow. Tag candidates list affected paths without actual diffs. The originating phase remains unknown.

C-main-GIT-028 (f90ceafe78b0, 2026-10-13) identifies frequenze_classi.py and regeneration of the protocol table from the actual experimental artefacts.
